title: [maintainer] AGPL license footprint not documented in reader deployment
description: usenet-ipfs-reader now imports usenet-ipfs-smtp (post/smtp_relay.rs:10), which depends on AGPL sieve via usenet-ipfs-sieve (CLAUDE.md line about 'reader was previously MIT, now AGPL'). This changes the license status of a major component deployed as a network service. Operator running reader as a service must provide source or face legal exposure. But: project README and CLAUDE.md do not clearly state this. Solo operator/future users could be surprised when license audited. Need: update project docs (README, CLAUDE.md §License) to explicitly warn that building usenet-ipfs-reader now requires AGPL compliance if using SMTP relay features.
